WITH
anomaly_data AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT au.metric_name) AS cnt
  FROM alerts_unified au
  LEFT JOIN statistical_patterns sp 
    ON au.metric_name = sp.metric_name
  WHERE au.severity = 'anomaly'
    AND au.time >= $__timeFrom() AND au.time < $__timeTo()
    AND au.station IN ($station)
    AND (
      (au.station NOT IN ('ced_station','ced_maintenance','gantry_positioning','system') 
        AND LOWER(sp.type_of_motor::text) LIKE '%%stepper%%')
      OR (au.station = 'ced_station' 
        AND au.metric_name IN ('pallet_movein_time','pallet_moveout_time'))
    )
),

degradation_data AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT (mp.metric_name, SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2))) AS cnt,
    MAX(
      CASE SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2)
        WHEN 'Trend Acceleration'   THEN 10
        WHEN 'Step Jump'            THEN 10
        WHEN 'Random Spikes'        THEN 3
        WHEN 'Slow Drift'           THEN 8
        WHEN 'Baseline Shift'       THEN 8
        WHEN 'Periodic Oscillation' THEN 8
        WHEN 'Variance Growth'      THEN 8
        ELSE 3
      END
    ) AS max_severity
  FROM model_predictions mp
  INNER JOIN statistical_patterns sp
    ON LOWER(SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2)) = LOWER(sp.statistical_pattern)
    AND mp.metric_name = sp.metric_name
  WHERE mp.model_name LIKE 'stats_pattern_detector::%%'
    AND $__timeFilter(mp.actual_timestamp)
    AND LOWER(sp.type_of_motor::text) LIKE '%%stepper%%'
    AND SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2) 
        NOT IN ('Slow Drift', 'Periodic Oscillation', 'Step Jump')
),

scored AS (
  SELECT
    'Anomaly' AS type,
    cnt AS count,
    CASE 
      WHEN cnt > 20 THEN 3
      WHEN cnt >= 10 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS health_score
  FROM anomaly_data

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'Degradation' AS type,
    cnt AS count,
    CASE 
      WHEN max_severity >= 8  THEN 2
      WHEN max_severity > 3 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS health_score
  FROM degradation_data
),

final AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(health_score) OVER () AS overall_health_score
  FROM scored
)

SELECT * FROM final;

SELECT
    mp.metric_name AS "Metric",
    SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2) AS "Pattern",
    COALESCE(MAX(sp.likely_causes_and_what_to_inspect::text), 'N/A') AS "Likely Causes & Suggestions",
    CASE SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2)
        WHEN 'Trend Acceleration' THEN 'Hours – < 1 day'
        WHEN 'Random Spikes'      THEN '3 – 14 days'
        WHEN 'Baseline Shift'     THEN '3 – 14 days'
        WHEN 'Variance Growth'    THEN '3 – 14 days'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "Recommended Time for Action",
    CASE SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2)
        WHEN 'Trend Acceleration' THEN 10
        WHEN 'Random Spikes'      THEN 3
        WHEN 'Baseline Shift'     THEN 8
        WHEN 'Variance Growth'    THEN 8
        ELSE 3
    END AS "Severity (Based on Impact)",
    COUNT(*) AS "Occurrences"
FROM model_predictions mp
INNER JOIN statistical_patterns sp
    ON LOWER(SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2)) = LOWER(sp.statistical_pattern)
    AND mp.metric_name = sp.metric_name
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(mp.actual_timestamp)
    AND mp.model_name LIKE 'stats_pattern_detector::%%'
    AND SPLIT_PART(mp.model_name, '::', 2) NOT IN ('Slow Drift', 'Periodic Oscillation', 'Step Jump')
    AND LOWER(sp.type_of_motor::text) = 'stepper'

SELECT 
    station AS "Station",
    metric_name,
    MAX(title) AS "Remark",
    MAX(detail) AS "Details",
    COUNT(*) AS "Occurrences"
FROM alerts_unified 
WHERE severity = 'anomaly' 
AND time >= $__timeFrom() AND time < $__timeTo()
AND station = 'ced_station'
AND metric_name IN ('pallet_movein_time','pallet_moveout_time')
GROUP BY station, metric_name
ORDER BY MAX(time) DESC
